actions.action: Confirm and freeze the exact selected scope
actions.mechanism: Separate the 25 visible rows from all matching records; confirmation freezes membership rather than a live filter.
actions.implementation: Provide keyboard-accessible scope choices. Resolve explicit IDs before confirmation; show actual count, filter summary, and target status persistently afterward.
actions.check: Confirm 600 IDs, then change filters and matching records; assert every submitted ID belongs to that confirmed set.
actions.risk: Membership resolution can become stale; require reconfirmation for additions.

actions.action: Skip records changed since scope confirmation
actions.mechanism: Conditional writes detect intervening edits instead of silently overwriting another person's changes.
actions.implementation: Capture record revisions alongside confirmed IDs. In the bulk handler, atomically compare each revision before updating; return conflicts as per-record outcomes.
actions.check: Modify a record after confirmation but before its write; verify it remains untouched and receives a readable conflict outcome.
actions.risk: Revision checks require backend work and may increase conflicts.

actions.action: Recover failures through a per-record operation ledger
actions.mechanism: Persisted outcomes separate successes, failures, and unresolved requests so recovery does not repeat successful writes.
actions.implementation: Store confirmed IDs under an operation key. Deduplicate writes by operation and ID; offer keyboard-accessible failed-only retry and polite screen-reader progress announcements.
actions.check: Interrupt a mixed-result batch, reopen it, and retry; verify successful IDs are not rewritten and unconfirmed IDs never appear.
actions.risk: Unknown outcomes need reconciliation; conflicts need review rather than blind retry.

actions.action: Explain reversal eligibility for each changed record
actions.mechanism: A timed, revision-checked reversal distinguishes expiration from subsequent edits and unsuccessful original changes.
actions.implementation: Store prior status, resulting revision, and policy deadline per success. Provide accessible eligibility reasons; atomically check deadline and revision when reversing explicit original IDs.
actions.check: Test unchanged, subsequently edited, expired, and originally failed records; verify only eligible records reverse and each rejection states why.
actions.risk: Eligibility can change after display; refresh reasons after attempted reversal.
